title: Paras Isn’t Giving the Orders
premise: Paras’s back mushrooms control it and order it to extract juice from tree trunks.
audiencePromise: Follow the clues from root-burrowing to the reveal that Paras may be controlled by its mushrooms.
openLoop: Are Paras’s mushrooms just feeding on it, or actually controlling it?
payoff: The mushrooms steal most of Paras’s nutrients, then control the bug and order it to extract tree-trunk juice.
engagementQuestion: Is Paras the bug—or the mushrooms’ puppet?

voice.instructions: Use a tense, curious pace. Stress the control reveal. Pause briefly before each reveal, then end with a playful challenge.

scenes.headline: THE MUSHROOMS GIVE ORDERS
scenes.narration: The mushrooms on Paras’s back are giving orders.
scenes.caption: PARAS MAY NOT BE IN CHARGE

scenes.headline: FIRST, IT DUGS FOR ROOTS
scenes.narration: First clue: Paras burrows under trees and gnaws roots.
scenes.caption: UNDERGROUND, IT TARGETS TREE ROOTS

scenes.headline: PARAS DOESN’T GET MOST
scenes.narration: But the mushrooms steal most of the nutrition Paras takes in.
scenes.caption: THE HOST FEEDS THE MUSHROOMS

scenes.headline: EXTRACT JUICE FROM TRUNKS
scenes.narration: Then they order Paras to extract juice from tree trunks.
scenes.caption: THE MUSHROOMS CHOOSE THE JOB

scenes.headline: THE BUG IS CONTROLLED
scenes.narration: The Pokédex confirms it: the mushrooms are controlling the bug.
scenes.caption: PARAS IS NOT THE BOSS

scenes.headline: BUG OR MUSHROOM PUPPET?
scenes.narration: Paras is the bug—or the mushrooms’ puppet?
scenes.caption: WHO IS REALLY IN CHARGE?
